name: AWS Fundamentals and Global Infrastructure
description: Understand the AWS shared responsibility model, accounts, Regions, Availability Zones, and the global infrastructure behind cloud services.

name: IAM, Roles, Policies, and Security
description: Learn how identities, roles, policies, and security services control access and protect AWS environments.

name: EC2, AMIs, and Auto Scaling
description: Explore virtual machines, machine images, instance choices, launch templates, and capacity that adjusts to demand.

name: VPC, Subnets, Routing, and Security Groups
description: Follow traffic through virtual networks, subnets, route tables, security groups, and network access controls.

name: S3 and AWS Storage Services
description: Compare object, block, and file storage, and understand S3 durability, access controls, lifecycle, and storage classes.

name: Load Balancing and Route 53
description: Understand health checks, traffic distribution, DNS records, and routing policies for resilient applications.

name: Lambda and Serverless Computing
description: Learn event-driven execution, serverless design choices, concurrency, and the operational trade-offs of managed runtimes.

name: RDS, DynamoDB, and Databases
description: Choose between relational and NoSQL data stores while considering availability, scaling, consistency, and backups.

name: ECS, ECR, Docker, and Fargate
description: Follow container images into orchestration, registries, task placement, and managed compute with Fargate.

name: CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and X-Ray
description: Use metrics, logs, audit events, and traces to understand service health, activity, and application behavior.

name: Backup, Disaster Recovery, and Reliability
description: Plan recovery objectives, backups, fault isolation, and resilient architectures for different business needs.

name: CloudFormation and Terraform
description: Manage infrastructure changes with declarative templates, reusable modules, state, and reviewable deployment plans.

name: CI/CD and Deployment Strategies
description: Compare automated delivery pipelines, deployment strategies, rollback options, and progressive release practices.

name: Cost Management and Troubleshooting
description: Investigate common cloud issues and reason about budgets, usage patterns, cost allocation, and optimization trade-offs.
